recommendations.action: Prioritise signal maintenance / CBTC inspection on the approach segment
recommendations.rationale: Signal alerts coincide with problem arrivals; recurring signal faults on one segment are usually a component issue.
recommendations.expected_effect: Removes the recurring gap source; typical APT reduction equals the segment's median excess run time.

recommendations.action: Check weekend / late-night planned service changes for R, N, D, W; use alternates other lines at the station
recommendations.rationale: Planned work is announced in advance.

recommendations.action: Review the general-order (planned work) schedule for R, N, D, W; add supplement trains or move work windows off the affected hours
recommendations.rationale: Problems coincide with planned service changes.
recommendations.expected_effect: Planned changes stop degrading the analysed hours.

recommendations.action: Prioritise infrastructure & equipment work orders on the R, N, D, W corridor near 4 Av-9 St
recommendations.rationale: Infrastructure categories over-index in MTA-reported delays for the line.

recommendations.action: Pre-position a signal maintainer during the affected hours on days with active work orders
recommendations.rationale: Response time dominates the delay length for signal failures.
recommendations.expected_effect: Shorter incident duration, fewer 50+ train major incidents.

recommendations.action: Track-bed cleaning and debris removal on the approach segment
recommendations.rationale: Fire/smoke alerts over-index; debris is the usual fuel.

recommendations.action: During the affected hours, check alerts for 'R, N, D, W' before entering; use the alternate routes other lines at the station when a signal alert is posted
recommendations.rationale: Signal-caused gaps last tens of minutes; alternates are usually unaffected.
